blind.description: A modular interior wall section featuring an open doorway. The front side displays rich reddish-brown wood wainscoting with raised/recessed rectangular panels, an ornamental doorframe molding with an upper pediment shelf, a smooth cream-colored plaster upper wall, and a multi-tiered crown molding at the top edge. The rear side is plain, flat beige plaster with the doorway cut through.
blind.from_above: A narrow light-cream rectangle with a slightly projecting beveled trim profile along one long edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: Slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 7 ft tall) and about 4.5 to 5 ft wide.
